identityRules: The caller’s literal identifiers remain request values. Exact equality is against applicationNumber, and id is the application entity key. This document contains no record identifiers or expected business outcomes.

keyword is a substring predicate and cannot encode an OR set by concatenating identifiers. Read the authorized collection under stable documented request context, then apply the exact identity filter.
Each displayed identifier must have exactly one verified application key; similarity, shared prefixes and related payment numbers establish no identity or relationship.
permissions: The current bearer identity is used for each operation; each native permission result remains authoritative. MyTodo.View and MyCompleted.View are separate server checks. This definition grants neither permission.
A native 401 or 403 is an access result, not an empty collection. Do not change account, use a different identity, guess internal IDs or bypass a denied read.

requestSemantics.keyword: Empty string removes only keyword narrowing in these supplemental reads. All caller-requested clauses still require independent final proof.
requestSemantics.serviceTypeId: String 1 is the source-defined all-service-types sentinel; it does not mean department 1, Licensing membership or Foreign Media.
requestSemantics.omittedOptionalFilters: Start/end dates, status, approval decision, category and service-code filters are omitted nullable DTO properties. This is a source-inspected contract, not proof of the deployed build. Never represent omitted values as captured non-null filters.
requestSemantics.pagination: Start with pageIndex 1 and pageSize 10. Only declared pagination fields may change during bounded two-pass collection; response page.total and stable projection determine completeness.

boundaries: These supplemental reads activate only for the reviewed bare_record_set request shape: an explicit exact identifier set with no selected view, added scope/date/predicate, or requested attribute/measure/order/group. A different shape requires its own already supported source path and cannot reuse this activation marker.
These reads locate application entities only; they are not enterprise-wide or cross-department performance access.

One complete collected source that verifies all requested identifiers can satisfy the existing exact-set output contract. If identifiers are split across two sources, preserve the gap until a separately reviewed server-owned multi-source proof contract exists.
Do not join two partial populations or unequal capture timestamps into an invented complete snapshot. Do not change timestamps or observation references to force compatibility.
A missing identifier in any one view is unobserved in that view, never proof of global absence. Keep each original identifier in the task and final evidence coverage.

Never replace user-requested status, SLA, date, scope or other attributes with this locator-only projection. Runtime collection must independently verify the deployed response, identity and completeness before any business conclusion.
